target.statement: Mean NMI of CGSD-CSpec on Wisconsin is 0.182 (vs. K-Means 0.140), the paper's headline win on a small heterophilic graph.

compute.basis: Wisconsin is tiny (251 nodes); the paper claims ~30 s end-to-end, so the cost is dominated by installing PyTorch/PyG, downloading the dataset, and running 5 seeds of a 2-layer encoder plus spectral clustering on CPU.

blockers: Code repo may be incomplete or not match the paper (only a GitHub link is given; no explicit configs/scripts verified)
Paper text contains inconsistencies (e.g., Cornell NMI=1.000 claim in appendix vs. Table 2 value 0.093; Table 4 default NMI differs from Table 2), which may complicate exact reproduction
Requires implementing the sheaf-diffusion encoder and CSpec clusterer if the repo is missing or outdated
title: Curvature-Guided Sheaf Diffusion for Unsupervised Community Detection on Heterophilic Graphs
